name: silveira
description: Repo root: Husky + lint-staged. After clone: npm install (root), npm install in wp-content/themes/silveira, and composer install in the theme for PHPCS/PHPStan. Pre-commit runs lint-staged (lint-staged.config.mjs) from the repo root.

scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -p silveira-e2e -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --wait
